effects.description: [On Play] You may add 1 card from your Life area to your hand: This Character gains [Rush] during this turn. (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
steps: (Optional) Add 1 card from your Life area to your hand
If you do, this Character gains [Rush] during this turn (it can attack immediately)
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
You may choose not to take a Life card if you don't want to
